name: REPORT PENDING WORK ORDER
query:
SELECT
    name AS `Work Order Number`,
    production_item AS `Item Code`,
    qty AS `Work Order Qty`,
    IFNULL(produced_qty, 0) AS `Completed Qty`,
    (qty - IFNULL(produced_qty, 0)) AS `Pending Qty`
FROM
    `tabWork Order`
WHERE
    docstatus IN (0, 1)
ORDER BY
    creation DESC;
